text:
Lena (AE): heads-up - closing NimbleCare today. Committed Dedicated 4xGPU + hosted fallback. They've asked for Okta SCIM, two custom SAML attributes (dept, cost_center), 24mo audit retention, and optional VPC peering. want PROD in ~6 weeks.
Priya (CSM): congrats! i'll take kickoff. Lena, drop contract link + pilot notes and any playbook artifacts.
Lena (AE): contract: https://redwood.example/contract/NIMBLE-2026. Pilot: steady 105 rps, p95 gen ~200ms, used streaming + rerank. cost matched quote.
Lena (AE): known risks: 1) legal retention ask (24mo) 2) custom SAML attrs not validated for their Okta org 3) potential peering timeline if they opt in.
Priya (CSM): Mei can you validate SCIM and SAML attribute mapping on a Dedicated tenant? also check whether we can export audit logs (S3 export + customer KMS) for 24 months.
Mei (SRE): I can run a staging pass. need Okta metadata or a test org admin invite. audit export to S3 supported but must validate KMS handshake and retention lifecycle. ETA 48-72h. if attribute transforms required, could add ~3 business days.
Omar (Support): i'll open support tickets for SSO/SCIM and audit export. will include pilot logs and link to this thread. will tag eng-platform if infra changes needed.
Priya (CSM): owners/action items: - Priya: kickoff + acceptance criteria doc and weekly cadence - Mei: SCIM/SAML compatibility report + retention export options by +72h - Omar: create and triage tickets by EOD - Lena: provide customer engineering contacts and confirm peering intent. marking Renewal_Risk=medium until retention is confirmed.
Mei (SRE): testing plan: 1) request Okta metadata 2) validate SAML claim mapping in staging dedicated tenant 3) run SCIM provisioning dry-run 4) test audit log export -> S3 w/ KMS handshake. will post results here.
Omar (Support): tickets: SUP-11077 "NimbleCare: SSO/SCIM validation" and SUP-11078 "NimbleCare: Audit export/retention" created and linked to eng-platform oncall. added pilot logs and contract link.
Priya (CSM): acceptance criteria (draft): ingest 100k tokens/day, p95 gen <250ms for generation routes, successful SSO login with mapped attrs, SCIM provisioning working for group sync, and archived logs accessible for 24 months.
Lena (AE): customer also asked for clearer per-routing policy cost breakdown. logging to product feedback board.
Mei (SRE): quick heads-up: if custom attribute transforms are needed server-side, that may require a small runtime config change and could impact a canary schedule by ~5 business days. i'll call it out in the report.
Omar (Support): @Mei include minimal repro and any config diffs in SUP-11077 so eng-platform can triage fast.
Priya (CSM): scheduling kickoff week of May 16. propose Wed 10am PT for initial sync. i'll send invite.
legal-bot: reminder scheduled: "NimbleCare onboarding kickoff" Wed 10:00 PT (Priya, Mei, Omar, Lena) :bell:
Priya (CSM): final note: capturing the audit retention ask as a compliance blocker until export + KMS verified. if we can't confirm a solution in 72h i'll escalate to legal. will also follow up on product feedback after onboarding baseline is stable.
